_doc: Entity temperatures (docs/NIGHT_OPTICS.md 'Entities', src/world/thermal.h), degrees C. human / zombie: core, skin (exposed, 20 C still air), face / hands offsets, cold_k (skin drop per C of air below 20), wind_k (per m/s). Zombies run cold (gameplay rule: dimmer on thermal; core 20..28). clothing: insulation per part role, T = air + (skin - air) / (1 + clo * k). corpse.tau: Newtonian cooling after death (s, gameplay-scaled). vehicle parts: rise_idle / rise_load (C above air running / at full rpm), heat_tau / cool_tau (s); brake_heat (C/s per m/s while braking), tire_speed_k (C per m/s). barrel: C per gram of muzzle heat (bal_muzzle, tau 8 s), max. sources: fixed emitters. sky: the apparent sky temperature (clear_depression below air at the zenith, cloud_keep under full cloud, exponent of the zenith -> horizon blend).
